name: 51 Trouble Gangster Crips
description: The 51 Trouble Gangster Crips (51 TGC), formerly known as Nothing But Trouble (NBT), are a predominantly African-American street gang located on the West Side of South Los Angeles, California. Originating in the early 1990s as a tagging crew, the group transitioned into a Crips-affiliated set established around 51st Street and Halldale Avenue, between Western and Vermont Avenues. They fall under the Gangster Crips (3x) alliance, also known as the Movin Gang.
